selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What question does the traveller ask when he turns toward the unseen realm?
questions.answer: He wonders what that hidden realm itself has to say.

questions.question: What evidence from the visible world prepares him for that search?
questions.answer: The crafted beauty, blessings, and remarkable works in the physical world.

questions.question: Why does the traveller reason that this One must also speak?
questions.answer: Because One who shows Himself through deeds and blessings would also make Himself known through speech.

questions.question: What conclusion does the traveller draw from these nonverbal signs?
questions.answer: That their Maker must also disclose Himself by speech.

questions.question: What does the passage say Allah does not do regarding knowledge of Himself?
questions.answer: He does not leave people to know Him only through created things.

questions.question: What does the passage say about relying only on the universe as proof of Allah?
questions.answer: It says that is not the only proof, since Allah also speaks about Himself.

questions.question: What makes the reality of revelation clear and undeniable for the traveller?
questions.answer: The agreement of a vast number of prophets, their united message about revelation, and the proofs and miracles found in revealed books and pages.

questions.question: What large-scale agreement supports the certainty of revelation?
questions.answer: The united witness of one hundred thousand prophets.

questions.question: How does the passage evaluate the joint proof of these revealed truths?
questions.answer: It calls that proof extremely strong, even stronger than sunlight proving the sun.

questions.question: When the traveller reflects on the unseen world, what main idea comes to his mind first?
questions.answer: He realizes that the Maker behind creation wants to introduce Himself.

questions.question: What does he infer from the abundance of beauty and blessing in the visible world?
questions.answer: He infers that there is a hidden Lord intentionally showing His qualities.

questions.question: What further conclusion follows from that first way of communication?
questions.answer: That He would also communicate by actual speech.

questions.question: Why does that prior communication lead naturally to the idea of revelation?
questions.answer: Because purposeful self-disclosure through acts points to self-disclosure through words.

questions.question: How strong is the testimony carried by revelation and inspiration?
questions.answer: It is presented as stronger than the testimony given by the universe and its beings.

questions.question: In evidential force, how does revelation compare with the testimony of creatures?
questions.answer: It is stronger and more decisive.

questions.question: What two things in divine speech make Allah known?
questions.answer: Its meanings and the fact that He addresses creation.

questions.question: How do both content and act function in divine speech?
questions.answer: The content tells who He is, and the act of addressing creation also displays His attributes.

questions.question: What written forms support revelation in addition to prophets?
questions.answer: Sacred books and heavenly pages with proofs and miracles.

questions.question: What intellectual move does the traveller make after looking closely into the unseen world?
questions.answer: He asks what message can be learned directly from that realm.

questions.question: What does he understand about the One behind the visible world’s artistry?
questions.answer: That this One intentionally reveals beauty, generosity, and perfection.

questions.question: What does “making Himself known by deed” mean in the logic of the passage?
questions.answer: It means creation and blessings already function as signs of who He is.

questions.question: What conclusion does the traveller reach from this silent testimony?
questions.answer: That direct speech from the hidden Lord must also exist.

questions.question: Why is revelation described as especially weighty evidence?
questions.answer: Because it comes from the Knower of the unseen and directly testifies to His existence and oneness.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah’s self-disclosure beyond creation?
questions.answer: He personally speaks and is not known only through His creatures.
